app.title: Proposal Arena
app.subtitle: Upload your proposal, configure your AI examiner, and start your defense.

steps.step1Desc: Ensure your proposal is in PDF format (Max 10MB).
steps.step2Desc: Click or drag the file into the area on the right.
steps.step3Desc: Configure your AI examiner and begin the defense session.

arena.confirmExit: Are you sure you want to exit the defense session? Your in-progress simulation will be stopped.

upload.title: Upload Proposal
upload.description: Drag and drop your proposal PDF here, or click to browse.
upload.readingSub: Checking methodology structure and research context...
upload.processingHint: The document stays in your browser while the selected provider prepares the analysis.
upload.languageDescription: The examiner, evaluations, and final report will use this language. You can change the detected result before continuing.
upload.selectFileAria: Select proposal PDF file to upload
upload.errorPdfOnly: Only PDF files are supported. Please upload your proposal in PDF format.
upload.errorNoApiKey: API Key is not configured. Please enter your API Key in Settings.
upload.errorUnknown: The file could not be processed. Please try again.

landing.headline: Proposal defense rehearsal.
landing.description: Upload your proposal, answer the examiner's questions out loud or in writing, then review your debrief notes.
landing.privacyNote: Your proposal is read in your browser, then its text is sent to {provider} for analysis. There is no server of ours in between.
landing.privacyDetailAria: Show privacy and data storage details
landing.privacyDetailStorage: Your proposal, defense transcripts, and debrief notes are stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB. Your API key stays in localStorage.
landing.privacyDetailPolicy: Text processing is subject to {provider}'s privacy policy and terms.

settings.title: Settings
settings.providerHint: Choose the AI service for the defense. Google Gemini provides a free quota.
settings.modelHint: The AI model used by examiners. Leave default if unsure.
settings.proxyHint: Use HTTPS. Any custom endpoint will receive your API key and thesis content.
settings.apiHint: AI access key from Google AI Studio. Stored locally in your browser.
settings.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear your stored API key and preferences?
settings.confirmResetData: Delete all proposals, sessions, reports, evaluations, and settings from this browser?

interview.confirmFinish: Are you sure you want to finish the defense now? The system will generate your debrief guidance and report.
interview.placeholder: Type your answer here... (press Enter to send)
interview.stagingSubtitle: Are you ready to start your defense?
interview.stagingDescription: The examiner will read the proposal context, then ask one question at a time. You can answer by typing or speaking.
interview.dictationUnsupported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Try Chrome.
interview.voiceToggleAria: Turn AI examiner voice on or off
interview.dictateAria: Turn on microphone for voice dictation
interview.dictateTooltip: Dictate answer (speech is automatically converted to text)
interview.sendAria: Send answer to the AI examiner
interview.handsFreeHelper: Answer out loud using your microphone without typing.
interview.switchToTypingAria: Switch back to typing on keyboard
interview.listeningAnswer: Listening to your voice... go ahead and answer
interview.handsFreePrivacyDesc: Hands-Free mode uses your browser's Web Speech API for real-time speech recognition. In some browsers (such as Google Chrome), voice audio may be processed on vendor servers (e.g. Google) for speech-to-text conversion. Your thesis document and evaluation remain private and local. You can pause or stop hands-free mode at any time.
interview.handsFreeUnsupported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Please use Chrome or Edge.
interview.handsFreePermissionDenied: Microphone permission denied. Falling back to typing mode.
interview.silenceAutoSubmit: [Candidate remained silent / No response provided within 30 seconds]
interview.timerHelper: Session ends when the time limit expires or 10 questions are reached.
interview.sessionEndingTimer: Time is up. The session has ended after your answer. Notes are being prepared...
interview.sessionEndingQuestions: Session complete. Notes are being prepared...

integrity.title: Session Integrity
integrity.warning: Warning: We noticed you switched tabs or minimized the window. For the integrity of the examination, please remain focused.
integrity.reportWarning: Session Integrity: You switched tabs or lost window focus {count} times during the defense.

report.title: Defense Debrief & Guidance
report.subtitle: Constructive evaluation notes and argument readiness mapping towards your actual proposal defense.
report.printAria: Open print dialog or save as PDF
report.copyNotesAria: Copy entire debrief notes to clipboard
report.emptyReport: Debrief notes for this session were not found.
report.demoBanner: Sample Preview: No thesis defense session has been completed in this browser yet.
report.strengthsDesc: Points of argument and understanding that are already sharp and should be maintained before the committee.
report.weaknessesDesc: Methodological or conceptual gaps that examiners are likely to scrutinize.
report.recommendationsDesc: Concrete preparation and revision priorities you can undertake before the actual defense day.
report.practiceDesc: Prompt questions to test the sharpness of your response and research defense logic.

tutorial.title: Gemini API Key Guide
tutorial.subtitle: Get a free API Key from Google AI Studio to run simulations.
tutorial.step1: Visit Google AI Studio at aistudio.google.com.
tutorial.step2: Sign in using your Google account.
tutorial.step3: Select 'Get API key' from the left navigation sidebar.
tutorial.step4: Click 'Create API key' and copy your generated key token.
tutorial.step5: Open Settings in this application and paste your API key.
tutorial.openSettingsAria: Open settings modal to enter API key
tutorial.privacyNote: Your API key is stored only in your local browser (localStorage) and sent directly to Google.
